title: World Cup 2026: Lamine Yamal, Kylian Mbappe, Lionel Messi, Harry Kane? Pick your World Cup semi-final XI - BBC Sport
text:
Would Spain's Lamine Yamal make your World Cup semi-final combined XI?

And then there were four - and what a final four it is.

Spain will face France on Tuesday, then defending champions Argentina play England on Wednesday.

And the sides are jam-packed with quality in every position - Lionel Messi, Kylian Mbappe, Lamine Yamal, Harry Kane...

If you had to pick a combined XI from the remaining four, who would you choose?

BBC Sport have had a go at picking their XI below and we want to see if you can do better.

Make your selections and comment on our choices below.
